對 TaCZ 的 MCS2 槍包 的 等價交換重置版的EMC值定價兼容

EMC pricing compatibility for ProjectE of the gun pack MCS2 for Timeless and Classics Zero

此 Mod 的核心作用 / The core function of this Mod

  • EMC pricing compatibility for ProjectE of the gun pack MCS2 for Timeless and Classics Zero

  • 對 永恆槍械工坊：零 (Timeless and Classics Zero) 的槍包 MCS2 的 等價交換重置版 (ProjectE) 的 EMC 定價兼容:

    槍械 / Gun 定價 EMC / Price EMC
    AWP 1,425,000
    USP-S 200,000
    Glock-18 200,000
    AK-47 1,350,000
    鬼魅 ghost 500,000
    正義 sheriff 240,000
    狂徒 vandal 1,450,000
    幻影 phantom 1,450,000
    冥狙 operator 940,500 (價格後續會調)
    M4A1-S 145,000
    CT/T Knife 45141

開發環境 / Develop Environment

  • Visual Studio Code
  • ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking

開發者的話 / Saying

​ 因為沒寫過Java嘛，所以全程都是用ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking寫的......嘿嘿

​ 我是寫C#後端的，雖然說語法相似但是看到好幾個檔案來回用和那一堆 import net.* 真的頭痛，而且 gradlew 能編譯但是編輯器給我爆了 107個錯誤

​ : - (

​ -- Rainbow SPY

​ 2026年5月15日 02:15

Because I haven't written Java before, the whole thing was written using ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking... hehe.

I write C# backend, and although the syntax is similar, seeing multiple files being used back and forth and that bunch of import net.* really gives me a headache. Also, gradlew can compile, but the editor threw 107 errors at me.

:- (

-- Rainbow SPY

May 15, 2026, 02:15 (UTC +8:00)

Known Issues / 已知問題

作為0基礎的C#開發者我實在無能為力修復這些問題，我是C#後端的，不是學java的 :-(

使用AI輸出所有疑似問題

  • EMC 匹配依賴精確的 minecraft:custom_data。

EMC matching currently depends on exact minecraft:custom_data.

  • TacZ 會在運行時動態修改武器 ItemStack，任何運行時字段變化都可能導致 EMC 失效。

TacZ dynamically modifies weapon ItemStacks at runtime. Any runtime field change may invalidate EMC mappings.

  • ProjectE 會比較完整 custom_data，而不是部分字段。即使只改動一個字段，也可能導致 EMC 消失。

ProjectE compares the full custom_data structure instead of partial fields. Even a single changed field can cause EMC to disappear.

  • Glock 切換 Burst 模式後 EMC 會失效。切回原模式後 EMC 會恢復。

EMC disappears after switching Glock to Burst mode. EMC returns after switching Glock back to the original mode.

  • 部分 Valorant 槍械（標配）使用右鍵運行時邏輯（右鍵爆炸開火），而不是 FireMode。

Some Valorant weapons use right-click runtime logic instead of FireMode switching.

  • Valorant Classic 標配 在創造模式中 EMC 正常。拿到手裡後 EMC 可能消失。

Valorant Classic shows correct EMC in Creative mode. Valorant Classic may lose EMC after being held by the player.

  • 創造模式中的 ItemStack 不一定等於運行時 ItemStack。

Creative inventory ItemStacks may differ from runtime ItemStacks.

  • TacZ 可能在裝備、換彈、開火、動畫時追加運行時字段。

TacZ may append runtime fields during equip, reload, firing, or animations.

  • EMC 映射對字符串拼寫極度敏感。

EMC mappings are extremely sensitive to exact string spelling.

  • 當前實現尚未完成 Canonicalization（規範化）。

The current implementation does not yet perform canonicalization.

  • 理論上只有 GunId、附件、彈藥數應該參與 EMC 身份判定。

Ideally only GunId, attachments, and ammo count should participate in EMC identity matching.

  • 當前運行時狀態字段仍然參與匹配。

Runtime state fields are still part of the matching process.

  • 當前項目更適合作為 TacZ × ProjectE EMC 的基礎框架。

The current project should be considered a foundation framework for TacZ × ProjectE EMC integration.

  • 當前項目屬於實驗性實現。

The current implementation is experimental.

  • 歡迎後續開發者繼續完善 Canonicalization 與 Runtime Filtering。

Future contributors are welcome to improve canonicalization and runtime filtering.
